title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $1,000 on the Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum & Mop
excerpt: Gran this deal and put your feet up.
content_html:
SAVE $1,000: As of Sept. 30, the Roborock Saros Z70 robot vacuum and mop is priced at $999.98 at Amazon. That's a 50% saving on the list price of $1,999.99.

Credit: Roboroc

$999.98 at Amazon
$1,999.99 Save $1,000.01

It might seem like there's never a good time to splash out on a robot vacuum — the best models are just way too expensive. But actually, there is a good time: right now, in fact.

Thanks to the early October Prime Day deals already live at Amazon, you can score a premium robot vacuum for far less than list price. The sale event doesn't start until Oct. 6, but already there's a 50% price cut on a seriously high-spec robot vacuum and mop combo, the Roborock Saros Z70.

As of Sept. 30, the Roborock Saros Z70 robot vacuum and mop is available for $999.98. It's usually priced at $1,999.99, so that's a massive overall saving of $1,000.01. According to the price tracker camelcamelcamel, that's the lowest-ever price for this model.

The standout feature of this robot vacuum is its five-axis OmniGrip arm, which protrudes from the vac and moves obstacles out of the way and even organizes small household items such as socks and other light debris. The arm uses cameras and precision sensors for accurate handling.

As for general cleaning, it has AI-powered SmartPlan technology that maps and navigates your home, switching between vacuum and mop modes and between carpet and hard floors. It's built with obstacle avoidance and uses AI to learn new objects. It can clean deep into corners and edges and even climbs thresholds and barriers with AdaptLift technology.
